name: github
description: Triage pull requests and issues, debug failing checks, work through review feedback, and publish changes, through the Caeros-native GitHub app.

interface.shortDescription: Triage PRs, issues, CI, reviews, and publish flows.
interface.longDescription: Work GitHub from inside Caeros: triage pull requests and issues, debug failing Actions checks down to the failing log line, work through unresolved review threads, and publish changes as a draft PR. Backed by the Caeros-native GitHub app, so there is no connector broker in the path and no CLI login required. The gh CLI is used only as a fallback for the few things the API cannot reach.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the open PRs in this repo and tell me what needs attention
Debug the failing checks on this PR
Work through the unresolved review comments on this PR
